parallels.note: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

translations.web: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
translations.bsb: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
translations.kjv: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
translations.asv: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.
